environment.platform: Linux 7.0.14-linuxkit #1 SMP PREEMPT Sun Sep 20 16:14:09 UTC 2026

corpus.shape: 500-commit agent-driven fixture from tools/agent_fixture.py: 3 agents and 2 humans, ~200 trailer-named turns over ~19 days, feature/fix/docs/migration/lockfile/CI/generated/reformat rotations plus ten planted risky episodes

samples_note: three samples per number; p95 of three samples is the maximum, and the report prints the samples so nobody reads p95 as a tail estimate

shell_frame_report.note: the product's own measurement of the quantity ADR-002 §6 budgets: draws over the whole run, and p99/worst/over-budget over the last 9 of them at 132x40. Printed by `fathom tui` on the way out and repeated by `fathom doctor`, from the same file.

measured.measurement: cold index of the 500-commit agent fixture
measured.note: three cold runs, each into a deleted store; the machine is one laptop, not the CI box
VmHWM of the index child; the graph lane is not built yet, so this is the spine alone

measured.measurement: store bytes per commit, spine tables only
measured.note: 2,166,784 spine bytes + 675,840 cache/other bytes = 2,842,624 in the file, for 500 commits; the split is dbstat's, so the cache the analysis wrote is not charged to the spine

measured.measurement: warm re-index after one new commit
measured.note: the new commit carries the fixture's trailers, so segmentation has work to do too

the run's own `elapsed_ms`, store-side: the ref comparison, the worktree pass and the tallies, with the walk, the analysis pass and the episode rebuild skipped (`reco-7tc`). The same runs timed fork to exit are 16.6 ms (15.9, 16.6, 16.4), of which the process start, `Repository::discover` and `Store::open` are the larger half — a toll every verb pays, and the reason `warm.reindex.noop.ms` is measured store-side like §13's rows are

measured.measurement: commit made elsewhere, noticed by `fathom watch`
measured.note: 0.6 s of warm-up is excluded: the clock starts at the commit, not at the spawn

measured.measurement: TUI: keystroke to a changed screen (p95, excluding the `g` chord)
measured.note: measured through the pty: keystroke written, screen grid changed. The worst value is 251.8 ms, and it is `g`, whose answer is the 250 ms chord timeout for `gg`, not the store. Not the shell's own draw time: that is in `shell_frame_report`, which is what ADR-002 §6 budgets
VmHWM of the TUI child, sampled after every keystroke

measured.measurement: TUI: the queue answers with a ranked worklist
measured.note: `q` until the screen printed `order: …` and a `risk` number — the queue's first frame is the answer now, so this is the time to the first useful answer and not to a paint (`reco-c05` wired the queue). On a cold store the queue is the default view, where the same instant is the first paint at 123.1 ms
keystroke written until the grid changed: the worklist redraws the ranked rows from the values the composition root handed it, and orders by them

measured.measurement: TUI: `w` explains why the selected episode ranks where it does
measured.note: keystroke until the card first printed what the ranking cannot see: the explanation arrives with its ceiling, not after it (`reco-c05`)

measured.blocked_by: the rail has no query of its own beyond the frame budget (query.frame_store_budget.ms.small): it lists the index in the index's order
search has no scorer yet — `/` says so, and the matcher is `e5.2`

measured.measurement: TUI: `d` to the diff pane painting its tree
measured.note: keystroke written to the pty until the grid changed, through the same pty as the frame-latency numbers; the pane draws the episode's file tree from the store's rows (`reco-0kw`)

measured.measurement: TUI: `d` to the first hunk on screen
measured.note: keystroke until the screen first printed an `@@` hunk header — the budget's own streaming rule (`hunk headers before bodies`), timed as it is written

measured.measurement: commit made elsewhere, noticed by an open TUI
measured.note: through the pty with the reviewer pressing nothing: `git commit` in another process until the open frame's grid changed, minus the time the commit itself took — the watcher's own budget, on the surface the ambient premise is about (`reco-bpc`)

not_measured: cold.graph.ms / warm.graph.marginal.ms / graph.materialise_revision.ms — the graph lane is e3.2's and is not built
